items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I don't know if she came from here, but she made some records with P. Rowan, so it's possible [INTERVIEWEE] that she came from here.

ctx.x: I don't know if she came from here, but she made some records with P. Rowan, so it's possible
